title: Classic Margherita Pizza
description: A crisp artisan crust topped with tangy tomato sauce, creamy mozzarella, and fresh basil.
steps: Preheat oven to 500°F (260°C) with a pizza stone inside.
Stretch the dough into a 12-inch circle and place on parchment.
Spread crushed tomatoes evenly, leaving a small border.
Tear mozzarella into pieces and scatter over sauce.
Top with basil leaves and drizzle with olive oil.
tips: Dust peel with semolina for easy transfer.
Let dough rest at room temp 30 minutes before stretching.

title: Coconut Chia Parfait
tagline: Creamy breakfast layered with tropical fruit.
description: Prep once, enjoy all week. Chia pudding layered with mango and toasted coconut.
steps: Whisk coconut milk, chia seeds, and maple syrup.
Chill 4 hours or overnight until thickened.
Layer chia pudding with diced mango in jars.
Top with toasted coconut before serving.
tips: Stir pudding once midway through chilling to prevent clumps.
Swap mango for berries when out of season.
